spec_match.rationale: Calls the real getPathData() on an editable d string, probes each of the three spec methods separately, and exercises both validation levels the explainer pins (structural TypeError observed; semantic leniency measured and the build's truncate-at-invalid deviation reported honestly against the skip contract).

interactive.rationale: Editable textarea, read button driving a live segment table plus rendered path, and a validation-probe button with per-probe readouts — all exercised headlessly with changing output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card promises structured reading plus a per-method surface probe, which is exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers empty d (returns []), unparseable input, missing-method fallback, partial-surface builds, structural TypeError, and the semantic-leniency deviation on mid-implementation builds.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 and the SVGPathData spec section in see-also.

conformance.rationale: The new v159 suite asserts the exact contracts this page demonstrates: typeof probes per method, {type,values} shape, relative-command preservation, roundtrip serialization, and empty-path [].

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 153 via Playwright-driven CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud session) in both unflagged and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI modes at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: all controls driven, readouts changed, zero console errors, zero failed requests, full-page screenshots read for geometry/contrast.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts surface probe, read result shape, validation-probes-ran, and the explicit fallback branch; no unexpected error events during headless runs.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables, buttons set background and color together, verdict/table contrast checked on screenshots, no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea, native buttons, aria-live on verdict and outputs, table semantics with scoped headers; keyboard focus follows native elements.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 screenshots show no horizontal overflow (fit-content dt column fix verified at both widths), 44px tap targets, and stacked kv grid under 480px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify semantic leniency on a real Chrome 159 build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI truncates the segment list at the first unknown-type/wrong-arity segment (and removes d entirely when the first segment is invalid) instead of the explainer's skip-and-keep model. The page reports whichever behaviour the visiting build has, but once Chrome 159 ships, confirm whether shipping behaviour matches the explainer and simplify the deviation copy if so.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep tabular data in real table semantics with scoped headers and let the wrapper scroll instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Segment table uses thead/th scope=col inside an overflow-x auto .table-wrap; verified zero page-level horizontal overflow at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scratchpad svg report3.json hOverflowPx=0 for all viewports

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface async/button-driven state changes through text in a polite live region rather than visual-only changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe verdict and both outputs are aria-live=polite elements updated after each action.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible labeling and keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Every input gets a visible, programmatically associated label.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The d-string textarea has a for/id label; buttons are native with descriptive text.

summary: Built and verified 2026-10-25 as part of the weekly hardening coverage sweep. Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment) exercised the read/edit/empty/validate flows in both flag modes and both viewport classes: unflagged shows the honest three-false surface probe and disabled-path fallbacks; flagged shows the real 6-segment read (M C S h a Z preserved), TypeError on structurally invalid input, and the measured truncate-at-invalid deviation reported against the explainer's skip contract. Conformance panel executed in-page: 7 pass / 3 fail flagged (getPathSegmentAtLength absent), 0 pass / 10 fail unflagged — failures render as fails, no crash.
